description.value: Connect Express is a café outlet located within BC Children's Hospital in Vancouver, a major pediatric hospital serving patients and families from across BC and Yukon. The hospital's food services page describes the affiliated connectcafé as offering a wide variety of food stations, baked goods, soups, a self-serve salad bar, and grab-and-go options. For touring cyclists passing through the Oakridge/Cambie area, this is a convenient indoor food stop in a large, publicly accessible institution.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 12m; stands (8 spaces) at 48m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Connect Express' and links to BC Children's Hospital's food-and-shops page. The website lists several food outlets including 'connectcafé' (the main hospital cafeteria), Starbucks, and Café 11, but does not explicitly list a unit called 'Connect Express' — the name suggests it may be a grab-and-go express counter affiliated with connectcafé, but this is not confirmed. Amenity details (vegetarian/vegan/GF, grab-and-go) are drawn from the connectcafé listing as the closest named match; bike-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the page.
